title: ستاره های سینما در لیورپول نمی میرند
titleEn: Film Stars Don't Die in Liverpool
description: Film Stars Don't Die in Liverpool is a 2017 biographical romantic drama film directed by Paul McGuigan and starring Annette Bening and Jamie Bell, with Vanessa Redgrave and Julie Walters. It is based on the memoir of the same name by Peter Turner, which tells of his relationship with American actress Gloria Grahame in 1970s Liverpool and, some years later, her death from stomach cancer.
